goal: Issue and check signed, expiring tokens.

tasks.title: Signed expiring tokens
tasks.description: src/auth/token.mjs exports sign(payload, secret, { ttlSec, now }) and verify(token, secret, { now }). A token is base64url(JSON {...payload, exp}) + "." + base64url(HMAC-SHA256 of that first part with the secret), exp = now + ttlSec in whole seconds; now is in ms and defaults to Date.now(). verify returns the payload (without exp) or throws an Error whose message starts with "invalid token" (bad shape, wrong signature, wrong secret) or "expired token" (now at or after exp). Compare signatures in constant time. An empty secret is refused by both with a TypeError.
scenarios: Given a payload {sub: "a"} signed with ttlSec 60 at now 0 When verified at now 59000 Then it returns {sub: "a"}
Given that token When verified at now 60000 Then it throws "expired token"
Given that token with one character of its payload part changed When verified Then it throws "invalid token"
Given that token When verified with another secret Then it throws "invalid token"
Given "abc" or "a.b.c" When verified Then it throws "invalid token"
Given an empty secret When sign or verify is called Then it throws a TypeError
